results.summary_before: This design implements an 8-bit posit multiply-accumulate (MAC) unit with a 32-bit quire register for exact accumulation. It takes two 8-bit posit inputs (es=2), multiplies them, and accumulates the product into the quire, which can be read back as a posit8 or cleared. The unit uses ready/valid handshaking and is controlled via a finite state machine, with data read/written through bidirectional ports. It is tested with a testbench that verifies basic operations, accumulation, and dot product fuzz testing against a float reference.
